'''Imperial Research Station 61''' was a classified scientific facility operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], it was run by [[Milosh Muhrlein]]. [[Jahan Cross]] worked undercover there for two weeks as he investigated the sale of illegal [[Droid/Legends|droid]] protocols and technologies.
